hypothesis: Does the passed Gaussian Q72 C-Q hinge transfer to TN-unseen stations and terminal trees?

nested_contract.LOSO: remove the held-out station's all training-year TN, refit H1 v_f, eta_quick, eta_gw and beta_low/beta_high, and predict only its temporal-fold evaluation-year TN
nested_contract.LOTO: remove every station in the held-out terminal tree from training TN and refit the same parameters
nested_contract.q_center: station/reach Q72 training-year all-month median; no TN sampling dependence
nested_contract.readout: P1 only; no station effect, held-out random effect or same-year TN filtering

absolute_benchmark: mean of training-station mean log1p(TN), giving every training station equal weight

relative_gate.ensemble_rule: at least 10/12 models noninferior in LOSO and at least 10/12 noninferior in LOTO

absolute_gate.skill: 1 - station-macro candidate MSE / station-macro equal-training-station-mean baseline MSE
absolute_gate.ensemble_rule: at least 10/12 models supported in LOSO and at least 10/12 in LOTO

confounding: a model is confounded if more than 5% of candidate nested fits fail or more than 10% hit eta, beta or v_f bounds; at most 2/12 confounded models
tree_163: mandatory separate open-lake-center domain diagnostic; excluded from primary-river LOSO/LOTO gates because it is not a river-outlet observation; not a post-hoc model-selection exception
